description: This pie chart visually represents the distribution of different relational association types within the MMRA benchmark, with each slice corresponding to a specific category and labeled with its count and percentage of the total. The chart contains ten distinct slices, each with a unique color and labeled text. Starting from the top and moving clockwise, the largest slice is labeled “NearSameEntity” with a count of 63 (6.34%), followed by “SimilarMaterial” with 106 (10.33%), “SubEvent” with 100 (9.74%), “UsageSimilarity” with 100 (9.65%), “Environment” with 90 (8.77%), “Layout” with 90 (8.77%), “AppearanceSimilarity” with 90 (8.77%), “SimilarEvent” with 90 (8.77%), “MentalitySimilarity” with 89 (8.67%), and “RelativePosition” with 81 (7.90%). Each slice clearly displays its label, count, and percentage, and the chart includes a legend that matches the colors to their respective categories. The slices appear to be arranged in descending order of size, with “NearSameEntity” being the smallest and “SimilarMaterial” being the largest visible slice.
